allocation: independent UniformInteger(0,7) per event; same assignment and external variables across scenario variants; no user dose quota

scm.participation: A=1[v<p]; observed acceptance record available; no response-based proxy
scm.physical: same one-way EV declared mechanism as D106; ref3kW, q1.5kW,request600..1800s,delay10*UniformInteger(0,7),dt10s; Pmax3.5+.75*(x+1), deadline3600+1800*(x+1), demand3*deadline/3600, repay afterrelease at Pmax-3

measurement: public request power =3-1.5*A*opening*1[t>=600+delay]+iid N(0,.05^2)kW; Yobs is integrated (ref-Pobs)*dt/(1.5*1200), signed/unclipped
target: group superpopulation mean response mu_g(d)=E[outcome(d)|g], averaged over conditional x,w and hidden U,V,delay,measurement; not an individual CATE or the finite empirical test-covariate target
truth: evaluation only GL32 vs64 for x,w,u and analytic V/delay averaging; x range[-1,0] or[0,1]; all is exactly .5 low+.5 high; no hidden variables read by estimators

methods.M0_dose_means: train-only empirical mean in each predeclared group/dose; requires min arm50
methods.M1_linear: train-only OLS basis[1,d] separately per group/outcome
methods.M2_linear_spline: train-only OLS basis[1,d,max(0,d-.8),max(0,d-1.6)] separately per group/outcome; knots fixed independently of DGP hinge1.2

fairness: same train users/group/factual rows for all methods; no covariate or post-treatment adjustment, because treatment randomized; group assignment uses pre-treatment x; no selecting only participants; fit A and delivery separately
selection: no hyperparameter or method tuning; validation loss diagnostic only. Compare all fixed methods after predictions persisted, no selected model refit on test

support.prediction: M0 only observed dose nodes; M1/M2 evaluated on same nodes; no extrapolation, no clipping or silent fixing monotonicity/probability violations

operational_threshold.meaning: first dose where group mean delivery relative to dose0 gains delta; not business requirement, economic optimum, price elasticity or structural kink
operational_threshold.output: adjacent dose bracket using only predicted supported node increments; not_reached if entire fitted gain below delta; ambiguous_nonmonotone if fitted means violate nondecreasing by >1e-10 (unless all gains remain below delta)
operational_threshold.truth_crossing: evaluator-only continuous root where identifiable in supplied DGP and separately grid bracket; algorithm never receives smooth interpolation truth
operational_threshold.uncertainty: brackets are design resolution, not confidence intervals; report error/available denominator; no user-cluster inferential claim

metrics: adjacent mean difference per yuan sensitivity RMSE
validation and test factual MSE separate
10pp/5pp crossing status, correct grid bracket, continuous-root containment, unavailable rate and unconditional spurious-crossing frequency in zero
isolation: user ids split before fitting, variants share split; save predictions and fit hashes before evaluator truth; latentU/V and noiseless curves only separate evaluator panel; raw only factual X,dose,user,split,A,Y
budget: 20x4x8400=672000 scenario factual rows;168000 base events/12000 independent user draws across repetitions; 240 group model packages each with 3 methods and 2 outcomes, no forest/DML/repeated test tuning; CPU only

open_source.NumPy: https://github.com/numpy/numpy BSD3; maintained existing runtime; OLS linalg.lstsq retained
open_source.SciPy: https://github.com/scipy/scipy BSD3; maintained existing runtime; special.expit, optimize.brentq evaluator only
open_source.not_adopted: PCHIP is interpolation, cannot identify unseen response shape or hard kink from seven randomized doses; statsmodels is mature BSD3 but extra inference machinery unnecessary for frozen point-estimate comparison
